Context: E. Hard Area Allowance

## E. Hard Area Allowance  
Central Government employees posted in the Nicobar Group of Islands and Minicoy in Lakshadweep Islands are entitled to Hard Area Allowance at the following rates:-  
| | Place where posted | Rate per month |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| (i) | Nicobar Group of Islands and Minicoy in Lakshadweep Islands | 20% of Basic Pay |
